name: MMDemo Company Dataset Contract

company.business: B2B industrial sensor/automation products, light assembly, project delivery, installation and maintenance

objective: exercise the MetaModule/DWH/Expose model with one coherent synthetic company whose operations naturally cross business, everyday and strategy compositions
realismRules: all aggregates must reconcile to underlying synthetic records where both are provided
sales must consume stock or trigger procurement/assembly rather than teleport inventory
sales invoices must relate to orders/deliveries and payments must relate to invoices
purchase receipts must increase stock and supplier invoices must relate to procurement
project/service work must have employees/time/evidence where applicable
strategy measurements must derive from operational demo data when possible
no personally identifying real-world data is used

coverageSemantics.rule: coverage labels are demo browsing/projection labels unless explicitly resolved to a current canonical MetaModule identity
coverageSemantics.mustNot: promote a demo label, historical registry ID or surface name into a current canonical member identity

relationGraph.semantics: synthetic explicit entity/relation graph over the same Q3 company data
